theme.title: Showtime
theme.subtitle: The Lakers of the 1980s
theme.recap: Magic Johnson's Lakers played fast, won big and left Finals marks behind, from a rookie's 42-point clincher to a perfect start to a postseason.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1986–87 Lakers win?
questions.note: 65–17, the best record in the league.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers finished the regular season with a league-best 65–17 record.

funFacts.text: Coach Pat Riley put more of Los Angeles's offense in Magic Johnson's hands, shifting responsibility away from the aging Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach Pat Riley made a strategical move, shifting the offensive focus to Magic Johnson.

funFacts.text: The Lakers acquired Mychal Thompson during the season to support Kareem and defend Boston's formidable frontcourt.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers acquired center Mychal Thompson via trade midway through the season.

funFacts.text: Golden State's Sleepy Floyd erupted for 51 points in the playoffs, handing the Lakers their sole loss before the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their only loss was a Sleepy Floyd 51-point outburst in Game 4 in Oakland

questions.prompt: As a rookie in the title-clinching Game 6 of the 1980 Finals, how many points did Magic Johnson score?
questions.note: 42, and he made all 14 of his free throws.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Magic Johnson scored 42 points, including all 14 of his free-throw attempts.

funFacts.text: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar suffered an ankle injury in the preceding game and did not even travel to Philadelphia for the title clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kareem did not make the trip and was listed as doubtful if Game 7 had been needed.

funFacts.text: Jamaal Wilkes added a spectacular 37 points and 10 rebounds in the title-clinching game, largely overshadowed by Magic's performance.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jamaal Wilkes with 37 points and 10 rebounds

funFacts.text: This was the first Finals played with the NBA's newly introduced three-point line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was also the first NBA Finals to make use of the three-point line

questions.prompt: The 1989 Lakers were the first team to win how many playoff games in a row to open a postseason?
questions.note: 11 straight, the first team ever to do it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers became the first team to win their first 11 playoff games

funFacts.text: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar announced his retirement before the season and received tributes in opposing arenas on a farewell tour.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: his 'retirement tour' consisted of pregame tributes in every arena

funFacts.text: The Lakers' winning run ended with an injury-riddled Finals defeat against Detroit's Bad Boys.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Pistons won the series in a four-game sweep of the injury-riddled Lakers

funFacts.text: The 1989 Lakers finished the regular season atop the West, but Detroit had the NBA's best overall record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Pistons dominated the Eastern Conference, winning 63 regular season games.

questions.prompt: Michael Cooper set a playoff record in Game 2 of the 1987 Finals by making how many three-pointers?
questions.note: Six, a playoff record at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He hit six 3 pointers, a playoff record.

funFacts.text: Michael Cooper was also the league's Defensive Player of the Year, an uncommon pairing with his long-range shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they had a strong defense which included defensive player of the year Michael Cooper

funFacts.text: Magic Johnson's famous junior sky hook in Game 4 helped define the Lakers' championship series against Boston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The key moment of the series was Magic Johnson's Junior sky hook in Game 4.

funFacts.text: The 1987 Finals were the first championship series ever scheduled entirely in June.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was the first NBA Championship Series conducted entirely in June.

questions.prompt: Magic Johnson set the NBA Finals record for assists in a game in 1984. How many did he dish out?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Magic Johnson dished out 21 assists, an NBA Finals record.

funFacts.text: Larry Bird took Finals MVP honors after averaging 27 points and 14 rebounds per game against Los Angeles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Celtics forward Larry Bird averaged 27 points and 14 rebounds a game during the series

funFacts.text: The following Finals used a different home-game order, designed to reduce travel after Boston complained to the league.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The following year, the NBA Finals format was changed to 2–3–2 after Celtics president Red Auerbach complained

funFacts.text: The rivalry had been building since Magic's Michigan State team beat Bird's Indiana State team for the college championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the final game of the tournament, Larry Bird and his erstwhile unbeaten Indiana State Sycamores lost to Magic Johnson
